projects.title: ThreatLens
projects.desc: AI-assisted application-security triage for CI/CD. Ingests scanner findings (Semgrep / SARIF), de-duplicates and clusters them into vulnerability classes, then uses an LLM to adjust severity, flag false positives, and generate remediation — with defenses against prompt injection. Outputs a live interactive dashboard and SARIF for GitHub Code Scanning.

projects.title: ADATT — Identity Security Automation
projects.desc: A commercial platform that automates secure employee offboarding across hybrid Active Directory + Microsoft 365 — account disable, full MFA/FIDO2 teardown, session/token revocation, license reclamation, and compliance-grade audit reporting. Built end-to-end with least-privilege OAuth and encrypted, no-credential-storage design.

projects.title: Identity Lifecycle Governance
projects.desc: Audit-driven automated onboarding/offboarding for IT-admin and MSP contexts across Active Directory, Entra ID, and Exchange Online — closing orphaned-account and standing-access risks that are a primary lateral-movement vector.

projects.title: AI Feedback Application
projects.desc: An AI application that collects and analyzes customer feedback to improve AI-agent behavior — applying AI development coursework to a working prototype.
